lines.zh: 我扑扇着滑腻的翅膀飞。
lines.en: I fly on slippery wings.
Slime drips off me constantly.
I skim the cave roof.
I drop, then spring up.

lines.zh: 黏液把我粘在天花板上。
lines.en: Slime sticks me to the ceiling.
Not fast. My wings are heavy.

lines.zh: 滴下来的东西在地上积了一摊。
lines.en: What drips from me pools below.

lines.zh: 我在石缝之间绕来绕去。
lines.en: I weave between the rock seams.

lines.zh: 我每一次转向都带一串胶。
lines.en: Every turn trails a string of gel.

lines.zh: 我从高处滑下去，不用扇翅。
lines.en: I glide down without beating.

lines.zh: 我的身体软，撞墙也不疼。
lines.en: Soft body. Walls do not hurt.
I hang from the roof and sway.

lines.zh: 我朝有光的地方飞一段。
lines.en: I fly a little toward the light.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀边缘还在拉丝。
lines.en: My wing edges still string out.

lines.zh: 我掠过你的头顶，滴了一点。
lines.en: I pass overhead and drip a little.
I climb; slime drags behind.
I hang upside down and sway.

lines.zh: 黏液在我身上凝成一层。
lines.en: Slime thickens on my skin.
The roof is cool and quiet.
I listen to cave drips.

lines.zh: 果冻似的身体，一颤一颤。
lines.en: My jelly body quivers and quivers.
I do not need much food.

lines.zh: 有东西落在我旁边，弹了一下。
lines.en: Something falls near me and bounces.
My wings have stuck together.
I peel them apart.
Only I move in this cave.
I wait for a bug to pass.
The smell of slime is thick.

lines.zh: 你踩到我滴下来的东西了。
lines.en: You stepped in what I dripped.
My wings will stick to you.
I see your torch.
Do not grab. It strings out.
Few people come in here.

lines.zh: 我身上这层东西，洗不掉。
lines.en: This coat will not wash off.
My core is one of the four.

lines.zh: 我落在你的火把上试试。
lines.en: Let me try landing on your torch.
Step back and I will drop.
That puddle is mine.
A lump of gel comes off.
I hit the wall and stick.
A layer of gel is gone.
I shed a lump and fly on.
That thinned me.
No pain. Just spilled.

lines.zh: 我贴在墙上歇了一会儿。
lines.en: I rest stuck to the wall.
A wing has torn a little.
That set my flight crooked.
The fallen piece still moves.
A bug? I want that.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，滴着水。
lines.en: What you raise is dripping.
Not bread. Too dry.

lines.zh: 这块东西会黏在我嘴里。
lines.en: That would stick in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你把虫子放墙上，我就去。
lines.en: Put the bug on the wall.
Jelly? Sounds like kin.

lines.zh: 甜甜的味道，我不太需要。
lines.en: Sweetness. I do not need it.
Do not shake. It falls.
That will stick with me a day.
Leave it. I will get it.
You hit me and pick up gel.
I bounce off, soft.
I stick to your shoulder.
Do not shake. It spreads.

lines.zh: 我的重量很轻，撞不疼你。
lines.en: Light. It does not hurt.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，我掉了些在上面。
lines.en: The bump leaves some of me behind.
You pull back; a string still connects.
I crawl back onto the wall.
Now your clothes need washing.
I slip past on one side.
My core is made of jelly.
The slime splits on its own.
I am alone in this roost.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，胶滴到地上。
lines.en: I quiver; gel drips to the floor.
The ceiling gel keeps building.
Stop. It sticks to the topic.

lines.zh: 我们只是滴下来，然后多了。
lines.en: We drip and become more.
The ceiling gel is bubbling.
Move. I am dripping down.
Too sticky a topic.

lines.zh: 这只虫子，我用翅膀卷住。
lines.en: I wrap the bug in my wing.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，黏在我身上了。
lines.en: Your dropped thing stuck to me.
I stick it loose.
Too sticky and heavy, I cannot lift it.

lines.zh: 东西落到我滴的那摊里。
lines.en: It fell into my puddle.
I haul it to the roof.

lines.zh: 我整块贴上去，拿不下来了。
lines.en: I stick to it entirely.
I stick your arrow to the wall.
You pick it up. I fly poorly.
I press it into the gel.
Something flew in.

lines.zh: 黏液滴在你肩上，我松开爪子。
lines.en: Slime drips on your shoulder; I let go of the ceiling.
This dive comes with slime.
I mark the moving shadow.
My wings press down.
Your torch is easy to see.
I will land on you.
No other way out of here.
Slime arrives first.
Now I release.

lines.zh: 我绕着你头顶的黏液味转圈。
lines.en: I circle the slime scent above your head.
Slime drips on your shoulder.
I lower by degrees.
You retreat; I follow.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀黏在一起了，慢一点。
lines.en: Wings stuck. Slower.
The puddle widens.
Hear the dripping?
I wait for you to slip.
Last circle. I drop.
You cannot dodge now.
I hit your face and stick.
A wingbeat leaves a patch of gel.
Not painful. Sticky.
I land full on your arm.
You fling me; I hit the wall.
Slime coats your eyes.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，只留下一圈黏。
lines.en: One bite leaves a sticky ring.
You retreat through gel.
That slows your walk.
I crawl back to the roof.
A drop of gel falls from the roof.

lines.zh: 石壁上多了一团软东西。
lines.en: A soft lump joins the wall.

lines.zh: 你听见翅膀上带水的声。
lines.en: Wet wingbeats.
My core can open the altar.
A small puddle appears.
Dripping starts in the cave.
I slide down from above.
One more of me in this cave.
The smell of slime thickens.
My wings open for the first time.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的黏液就干了，翅膀发脆。
lines.en: Fire dried my slime; my wings went brittle.
I land flat and spread.
Water loosens my edges.
The blast splatters me on the wall.
An arrow leaves a hole.
Arts set my gel.
No bugs and I shrink.

lines.zh: 雷光把洞照亮，我缩了一下。
lines.en: Lightning lights the cave; I shrink.
The cave floor splits to void.
